text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hussein meets EU troika, praises European efforts for Middle East peace. King gets phone call from Palestinian Authority President Arafat, affirms Jordan's stand and support for efforts to implement Palestinian-Israeli accords.
- Prime Minister Kabariti, meeting Saudi prince Talal bin Abdul-Aziz, says relations between two countries are growing.
- Kabariti and PLO official Kaddoumi discuss Israeli redeployment in Hebron.
- Indonesian President Suharto in Amman today for talks on developing cooperation.
- Trade Minister Abu al-Ragheb and his Iraqi counterpart Saleh agree on Jordanian supplies to Baghdad worth $35 million.

- Labour Minister Shakhanbeh says U.N. Gulf War reparations committee decided in Geneva on sixth and final tranche of payments to Jordanians worth $18.7 million, covering 4,250 cases. Committee rejected 12,900 compensation requests.
- Jordan sceptical Cairo summit will achieve economic breakthrough.
